justification: Both are shallow relief carvings on stone that use horizontal banding to divide the field, and both include a distinct circular/disc element, but that is where correspondence ends. A is a single free-standing vertical monolith covered in large, coarse, curvilinear and abstract motifs, whereas B is an extensive flat wall face with fine, regular registers of small repeated figures, animals and a tree in orderly procession — utterly different in scale, density and manner of cutting.
